structured.approach: Attempt 3 fixes the G1 refusal. The CR-4 row said without qualification that provider acme-llm and model acme-text-2 do not change. That overstated feat.prebacklog, which says only that the ticket itself asks for no change of provider or model. It also conflicted with PROV-ACME-2026-11, which replaces acme-text-2 with acme-text-3 because of a deprecation on 2026-12-01. The row now states the current model, limits 'no change' to this ticket, and points to the PROV-ACME-2026-11 model swap. OQ-3 now asks about ordering and about which model the CR-4 tests run against. I checked the rest of the file for similar unscoped statements and found none. All cited requirement files were opened with Read in this session. The rest of the classification is unchanged: New Feature, Not Technical Only, a Technical sub-category for each CR, no duplicates merged, related items grouped, and the impacted repositories taken from the routing maps. I rewrote the file in full.

claims.text: FEAT-ZD-48600 is classified as New Feature. It adds delays_by_vendor, vendor_risk, overdue_with_risk and renderOverdueRisk, plus an optional paid_date feed column. The source item's type tag is also New Feature.
The qualifier is Not Technical Only, because the item adds a customer-visible overdue-risk table in ap_portal for AP managers. Each change request has a Technical sub-category.
Existing signatures are kept ('Keep every existing signature; add new functions'). build_explanation_request only gains an optional risk argument.
ap_forecast currently uses provider acme-llm, model acme-text-2, for the payment-delay explanation. Ticket ZD-48600 itself asks for no change of provider or model.

PROV-ACME-2026-11 separately replaces acme-text-2 (deprecated on 2026-12-01) with acme-text-3 and adds a system field to the same explanation requests. CR-4 changes the same function, so the two need ordering.
The risk tier is T2 with no payment execution, and the risk label is advisory only.
No duplicates were merged. ZD-48501 and ZD-48211 share the rule of more than 30 days past due for unpaid invoices but ask for different outputs.
ZD-48455 highlights rows of the portal aging table with class row-overdue. It is not a duplicate of the overdue-risk table.
ZD-48470 (feed v2 adds currency) touches the same vendor feed as CR-1 (feed v3 adds paid_date). It is related, not a duplicate.
PROV-ACME-2026-11 says explanation requests must keep max_tokens at 300, while FIN-OPS-2026-07 reduces it from 300 to 200. This conflict is raised for the PM.
ZD-48510 asks for payment execution, which is out of scope for this item. It is not grouped.
ZD-48377, RETRO-2026-19, ZD-48480 and REG-LPR-2026-4.2 concern ap_aging buckets, error messages, README definitions and the Late rule at more than 60 days. They are not duplicates.

Impacted repositories: ap_pipeline (Data Engineering Coding Agent), ap_forecast (Data Science Agent), ap_aging (Backend Coding Agent), ap_portal (Frontend Coding Agent). End-to-end tests go to the Testing Agent.
CR-5 has to follow D-2026-044 and L-011 (Decimal amounts) and D-2026-050 (paid invoices excluded).

open_questions: OQ-1: Should ZD-48501, ZD-48211 and CR-5 share one overdue definition in ap_aging ('unpaid and more than 30 days past due')? Nothing was merged.
OQ-2: CR-1 names feed v3, and ZD-48470 brings feed v2 (currency). Must ZD-48470 be delivered first?

OQ-3: PROV-ACME-2026-11 (acme-text-2 to acme-text-3, plus a system field) and CR-4 (risk argument) both change build_explanation_request. Which order should they land in, and should the CR-4 tests run against the model current at delivery? Separately, PROV-ACME-2026-11 (keep max_tokens at 300) conflicts with FIN-OPS-2026-07 (reduce it to 200).
OQ-4: Should org/org.routing_map.md be updated with the owners of ap_pipeline, ap_forecast and ap_portal? Today they exist only in the feature override.

Carried forward from feat.prebacklog: Q-1 (duplicate check against the board), Q-2 (is feed v3 a registered connector), Q-3 (notification channel), Q-4 (unpaid row with a paid_date), Q-5 (HTML escaping in renderOverdueRisk).
structured.summary: I rewrote feat.classification for FEAT-ZD-48600 in full. The CR-4 row now says that only this ticket asks for no provider or model change, and it links the separate model swap from acme-text-2 to acme-text-3 in PROV-ACME-2026-11 (OQ-3). The classification is unchanged: New Feature with the qualifier Not Technical Only, a Technical sub-category for each of CR-1 to CR-7, and no duplicates merged. Six related items are grouped, and the max_tokens conflict between PROV-ACME-2026-11 and FIN-OPS-2026-07 is flagged. Impacted repositories: ap_pipeline, ap_forecast, ap_aging, ap_portal. All open questions are non-blocking.
